SELECT DISTINCT ?cue
WHERE {
  ?case a app:InspectionCase .
  ?case app:hasHazardFinding ?finding .
  ?finding a app:HazardFinding .
  ?finding app:hasFindingStatus ?status .

  # '명확'하게 판단된 경우
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?status)), "명확") || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?status)), "확정"))

  # 작업자 추락 위험(낙상/추락) 관련 찾기
  ?finding app:concernsHazard ?hazard .
  FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?hazard)), "추락") || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?hazard)), "낙상"))

  ?finding app:hasVisualCue ?cue .
  ?cue a app:VisualCue .

  # 근거가 되는 관찰
  ?cue app:basedOnVisualObservation ?obs .
  ?obs a app:VisualObservation .
}
LIMIT 50

SELECT DISTINCT ?sanctionType
WHERE {
  ?exposure a app:PenaltyExposure ;
            app:penaltyExposureStatus core:DIRECT .

  ?rule a pen:PenaltyRule ;
        app:hasPenaltyExposure ?exposure ;
        pen:hasSanctionType ?sanctionType .
}
LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT ?accidentOutcome ?criminalSanction ?administrativeFine
WHERE {
  ?exposure a app:PenaltyExposure ;
            pen:hasAccidentOutcome ?accidentOutcome .

  OPTIONAL {
    ?exposure pen:leadsToCriminalSanction ?criminalSanction .
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?exposure pen:leadsToAdministrativeFine ?administrativeFine .
  }
}

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>
PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>
PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>

PREFIX guide: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/guide#>
PREFIX risk: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk#>
PREFIX haz: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk/hazard#>
PREFIX ctx: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk/context#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?penaltyCondition ?isSatisfied
WHERE {
  ?case a app:InspectionCase ;
        app:hasPenaltyExposureStatus ?status .

  ?exposure a app:PenaltyExposure ;
            app:penaltyExposureStatus ?status .

  ?rule a pen:PenaltyRule ;
        app:hasPenaltyExposure ?exposure ;
        pen:hasPenaltyCondition ?penaltyCondition .

  # 충족 여부는 해당 케이스의 조건 상태로부터 판정(온톨로지 상 프로퍼티를 일반 형태로 가정)
  OPTIONAL {
    ?case pen:satisfies ?penaltyCondition .
    BIND(true AS ?isSatisfied)
  }
  FILTER(!BOUND(?isSatisfied))
  BIND(false AS ?isSatisfied)
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>
PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>
PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>

PREFIX guide: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/guide#>
PREFIX risk: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk#>
PREFIX haz: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk/hazard#>
PREFIX ctx: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk/context#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?normStatement ?modality ?exemptedBy
WHERE {
  ?normStatement a law:NormStatement ;
                  core:bindingForce ?bindingForce .

  ?normStatement core:hasModality ?modality .
  FILTER(?modality != core:BindingForce)

  # Exemption 모달리티인 경우만(개념 개체 URI는 온톨로지 내 실제 값에 맞춰야 함)
  FILTER EXISTS { ?modality rdf:type core:Modality . }
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?modality)) LIKE "%exempt%" || STR(?modality) = "")

  ?modality core:exemptedBy ?exemptedBy .
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>
PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>
PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>
PREFIX pen: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/penalty#>
PREFIX guide: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/guide#>
PREFIX risk: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk#>
PREFIX haz: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk/hazard#>
PREFIX ctx: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk/context#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?sanctionType ?penaltyRule ?penaltyExposure
WHERE {
  ?exposure a app:PenaltyExposure ;
            app:hasSeverity ?severity .

  FILTER(?severity >= ?highThreshold)

  ?rule a pen:PenaltyRule ;
        pen:severityCondition pen:highSeverity ;
        pen:hasSanctionType ?sanctionType ;
        pen:connectsToPenaltyExposure ?exposure .

  # threshold 값(온톨로지에서 highSeverity의 기준값을 별도 개체로 관리한다는 가정)
  OPTIONAL { ?rule pen:highSeverityThreshold ?highThreshold . }
  BIND(IF(BOUND(?highThreshold), ?highThreshold, 0) AS ?highThreshold)
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>
PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>
PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT
  ?uploadedPhoto
  ?situationMatch
  ?safetyRequirement
  ?article
WHERE {
  ?uploadedPhoto rdf:type app:UploadedPhoto .
  ?situationMatch rdf:type app:SituationMatch ;
                   app:uploadedPhoto ?uploadedPhoto ;
                   app:matchesSituation ?safetyRequirement .

  ?safetyRequirement rdf:type sr:SafetyRequirement ;
                      sr:violatedBySituationMatch ?situationMatch .

  ?safetyRequirement sr:basedOnArticle ?article .
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>
PREFIX law: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/law#>
PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>

PREFIX risk: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT
  ?hazardFinding
  ?hazard
  ?safetyRequirement
  ?article
  ?hazardDependency
WHERE {
  ?hazardFinding rdf:type app:HazardFinding ;
                 app:judgesHazard ?hazard ;
                 app:connectsToSafetyRequirement ?safetyRequirement .

  ?safetyRequirement rdf:type sr:SafetyRequirement ;
                      sr:basedOnArticle ?article .

  OPTIONAL {
    ?hazardFinding app:hasHazardDependency ?hazardDependency .
  }
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>
PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>
PREFIX ctx: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/risk/context#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT
  ?visualObservation
  ?ppeState
  ?hazardFinding
  ?safetyRequirement
WHERE {
  ?visualObservation rdf:type app:VisualObservation ;
                      app:observesContext ?ppeState .
  ?ppeState rdf:type ctx:PPEState ;
            ctx:hasPPEViolation true .

  ?hazardFinding rdf:type app:HazardFinding ;
                  app:derivedFromObservation ?visualObservation ;
                  app:connectsToSafetyRequirement ?safetyRequirement .

  ?safetyRequirement rdf:type sr:SafetyRequirement .
}
LIMIT 100

  ?situationMatch rdf:type app:SituationMatch ;
                   app:matchesWorkActivity ?workActivity ;
                   app:mapsToChecklistItem ?checklistItem .

  ?checklistItem rdf:type guide:ChecklistItem .
}

SELECT
  ?penaltyExposure
  ?safetyRequirement
  ?sanctionType
WHERE {
  ?penaltyExposure rdf:type app:PenaltyExposure ;
                    app:confirmsViolationOf ?safetyRequirement ;
                    app:hasSanctionType ?sanctionType .

  ?safetyRequirement rdf:type sr:SafetyRequirement .
  ?sanctionType rdf:type pen:SanctionType .
}

PREFIX pen: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/penalty#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT
  ?penaltyExposure
  ?penaltyCondition
  ?accidentOutcome
  ?administrativeFine
WHERE {
  ?penaltyExposure rdf:type app:PenaltyExposure .

  ?penaltyExposure app:hasPenaltyCondition ?penaltyCondition ;
                    app:hasAccidentOutcome ?accidentOutcome ;
                    app:leadsToAdministrativeFine ?administrativeFine .

  ?administrativeFine rdf:type pen:AdministrativeFine .
  ?penaltyCondition rdf:type pen:PenaltyCondition .
  ?accidentOutcome rdf:type pen:AccidentOutcome .
}
LIMIT 100

PREFIX core: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology#>
PREFIX app: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/app#>
PREFIX sr: <https://cashtoss.info/ontology/sr#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT
  ?regulatoryAuthority
  ?inspectionCase
  ?correctiveAction
  ?safetyRequirement
WHERE {
  ?regulatoryAuthority rdf:type core:RegulatoryAuthority .

  ?inspectionCase rdf:type app:InspectionCase ;
                   app:requestedBy ?regulatoryAuthority ;
                   app:hasCorrectiveAction ?correctiveAction .

  ?correctiveAction rdf:type app:CorrectiveAction ;
                     app:respondsToViolationOf ?safetyRequirement .

  ?safetyRequirement rdf:type sr:SafetyRequirement .
}
LIMIT 100
